description: Scales Planetary Industry infrastructure and factory cycle times: command center CPU and powergrid, link bandwidth, the storage of launch pads, storage facilities and command centers, and the cycle time of P1, P2, P3 and P4 schematics. The server and the client both apply each setting, so the colony screen shows and checks the same numbers the server enforces.

fields.label: Command center fitting multiplier
fields.description: Multiplies command center CPU and powergrid at every upgrade level. 1 = retail, 2 = double, 0.5 = half. Upgrade costs and what each structure uses stay retail. Restart the server; players see the new value at their next login.

fields.label: Connection bandwidth multiplier
fields.description: Multiplies the bandwidth of every link, at every link level. 1 = retail, 2 = double, 0.5 = half. Restart the server; players see the new value at their next login.

fields.label: Storage capacity multiplier
fields.description: Multiplies the storage of launch pads, storage facilities and command centers. 1 = retail, 2 = double, 0.5 = half. Restart the server; players see the new value at their next login.

fields.label: P1 schematic duration multiplier
fields.description: Multiplies the cycle time of schematics that make P1 commodities (retail 30 minutes), rounded to whole seconds. 1 = retail, 0.5 = twice as fast, 2 = half as fast. Output per cycle stays retail, so inputs are used up at the new speed too. Restart the server; players see the new value at their next login.

fields.label: P2 schematic duration multiplier
fields.description: Multiplies the cycle time of schematics that make P2 commodities (retail 60 minutes), rounded to whole seconds. 1 = retail, 0.5 = twice as fast, 2 = half as fast. Output per cycle stays retail, so inputs are used up at the new speed too. Restart the server; players see the new value at their next login.
